message.content: I’m not sure what the exact exchange rate is right now, but as a rough estimate you could expect about £15–£16 for $20 (roughly $1 ≈ £0.78). If you need a precise figure, you’ll want to check a live currency converter or your bank’s current rate.

So we can answer with approximate conversion. But we don't have real-time data. We can provide approximate based on known rates. But we might not have up-to-date. We can say approximate. Or we can ask for clarification. But likely they want an estimate. We can respond with approximate conversion using typical exchange rate. Let's assume 1 USD ~ 0.78 GBP. So $20 ~ £15.60. But we should note it's approximate.
